editorialNote.zh: 把七天21篇研究收敛为“恢复即重新准入”，并系统串联重建、当前权威、发生身份与生命周期，综合性很强；不足是统一模型仍主要来自跨文综合，缺少单一端到端恢复实验验证。
editorialNote.en: It synthesizes twenty-one notes into a strong recovery-as-re-admission model spanning reconstruction, current authority, occurrence identity, and lifecycle closure; the unified model is still cross-note synthesis rather than one end-to-end recovery experiment.
